description:
You find yourself in a kitchen. A normal kind of place. You begin to take stock of what's in the room.

You can see an opened fridge. The fridge contains a yellow bell pepper. You can see an opened oven in the room. The oven is empty, what a horrible day! You see a gleam over in a corner, where you can see a table. Wow, isn't TextWorld just the best? The table is massive. On the table you see a cookbook. You shudder, but continue examining the room. You can make out a counter. The counter is vast. But the thing hasn't got anything on it. It would have been so cool if there was stuff on the counter. You see a stove. The stove is conventional. But the thing hasn't got anything on it. Oh! Why couldn't there just be stuff on it?
